# Art Zone Printing (آرت زون للطباعة)

> Art Zone Printing is a print and packaging factory in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, since 2016: paper cups, boxes, bags, business cards, labels, signage and corporate gifts, delivered Kingdom-wide.

Print, packaging and signage manufacturer based in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. In operation since 2016. Bilingual site: Arabic at the root, English under /en/.

## Services
- Business Cards & Paper Prints (مطبوعات الشركات والبطاقات الفاخرة): Business cards on standard or premium stock, with a dedicated foil and spot-UV line, plus letterheads, envelopes, profiles, brochures and folders. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/business-cards/
- Restaurant & Café Packaging (بكجات ومستلزمات المطاعم والمقاهي): Paper and plastic cups in every size, printed with SFDA-approved food-safe ink, plus all kinds of paper boxes, wraps and greaseproof paper. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/paper-cups/
- Boxes (صناديق وعلب التغليف الفاخرة): A dedicated line for boxes in hardcover, Forex and acrylic — built and printed in-house. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/boxes/
- Paper Bags (الأكياس الورقية التجارية): All paper bags for restaurants and cafés, every size, with or without handles, printed in eco-friendly ink. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/paper-bags/
- Stickers & Labels (الملصقات التجارية والليبلات): All plastic and paper stickers, roll stickers for dates and products in any shape, plus fabric labels for tailors. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/stickers-labels/
- Exhibitions & Events (تجهيز المعارض والفعاليات والمؤتمرات): A dedicated division for events, festivals, exhibitions, wooden project hoardings and everything an occasion needs.
- Lightbox & Wayfinding Signs (اللوحات الإعلانية والمضيئة والإرشادية): All indoor and outdoor lightbox signage, steel structures, and wayfinding signs for projects and roads. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/signage/
- Promotional Gifts (الهدايا الدعائية والترويجية للشركات): A dedicated gifts division — gift boxes, USB drives, planners and mugs, plus t-shirt printing and embroidery. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/corporate-gifts/
- Print Consulting (الاستشارات الفنية والطباعية): A dedicated desk for your printing questions — we help you reach the solution that best serves your product.
- Book Printing & Binding (طباعة وتجليد الكتب والمجلات): A dedicated division for printing books, novels and magazines, with binding.
- Newborn & Family Events (مطبوعات المناسبات والاستقبالات): A dedicated division for newborns and family occasions — Forex stands, table cards and congratulation invites.
- Graduation Projects (مجسمات ومشاريع التخرج المتخصصة): A dedicated division for building graduation projects from Forex and acrylic.
- Banner & Wide-Format Printing (طباعة البنرات والطباعة العريضة): Banner printing and installation, project hoardings, and canvas and fabric printing on the wide-format line. — https://art-zone-print.com/en/services/banners/

## Guides
- [Paper cup sizes: which size suits your café?](https://art-zone-print.com/en/guides/paper-cup-sizes/): Paper cups are usually sized in fluid ounces (oz); one ounce is about 30 ml. Four sizes cover most cafés: 4 oz for espresso, 8 oz for cappuccino and flat white, 12 oz for lattes and regular drinks, and 16 oz for large drinks. Most cafés need only two or three of them.
- [Offset vs digital printing: the difference and when to use each](https://art-zone-print.com/en/guides/offset-vs-digital-printing/): Digital printing prints straight from the file with no plates, so it suits short runs, urgent jobs and personalised copies. Offset needs plates and press setup, but the cost per piece falls as quantity rises and colour stays more consistent, so it suits large runs.
- [How to prepare a print-ready file: a checklist before you send](https://art-zone-print.com/en/guides/print-ready-files/): A print-ready file is usually in CMYK, at 300 dpi at final size, with about 3 mm of bleed on every side and fonts outlined or embedded, exported as a PDF. Special finishes such as foil, spot UV and die-cut lines need their own separate layers.
- [Print finishes explained: foil, spot UV, lamination and die-cutting](https://art-zone-print.com/en/guides/print-finishes/): Finishes are steps after printing that protect a piece and lift the brand. Lamination covers the whole surface in gloss, matte or soft-touch; hot foil adds metallic gold, silver or holographic shine; spot UV adds a raised clear gloss to selected elements; and die-cutting gives the piece a custom shape.
- [Paper types and weights: which paper suits your print?](https://art-zone-print.com/en/guides/paper-types-weights/): Paper weight is measured in grams per square metre (gsm). Office paper is around 80 gsm, flyers and brochure pages 115–170 gsm, covers and menus 200–300 gsm, and business cards usually 300–350 gsm. The paper type — coated, uncoated or kraft — shapes the feel and how colour looks as much as the weight does.

## Industries served
- Cafés & restaurants: Everything restaurants and cafés need — cups, brochures and all kinds of food-grade boxes.
- Home businesses: We support home businesses with small runs — wrapping paper, boxes and abaya packaging in low quantities.
- Events & exhibitions: A dedicated division for designing and building large-scale exhibitions and events, with a full crew specialized in booths and exhibition fit-out.
- Corporate & offices: We fit out new office locations end to end — acrylic wall signs, nameplates and building wayfinding signage.
- Clinics & beauty: We supply clinics and hospitals with waste bags and labels, sourcing the newest, best-looking models available.
- Startups & founders: Launch-ready brand kits in small, flexible runs — then scale the volume when you do.

## FAQ
- How fast will I get a quote? Minutes, during working hours. Send the product, quantity and deadline — pricing and timeline come straight back.
- Do you deliver outside Dammam? Yes — we ship to every city in Saudi Arabia, packed and tracked.
- Can you prepare the design? Yes. Our prepress team prepares print-ready files and sends a digital proof for your approval before anything runs.
- What files do you accept? Anything from finished print-ready PDFs to a rough idea — we will take it from there.
